# install.sh dry run, profile spark, dedicated box (root, systemd, /opt/raum)
# generated by deploy/install-dryrun.sh on Darwin arm64, 2026-11-02T15:04Z
# $ PATH=<fake nvidia-smi>:$PATH RAUM_FAKE_OS=Linux RAUM_FAKE_ARCH=aarch64 RAUM_FAKE_MEM_GB=121 ./install.sh --dry-run

RAUM installer
  machine : Linux aarch64, 121 GB RAM, GPU: NVIDIA GB10, [N/A]
  profile : spark
  repo    : <repo>
  mode    : dry run (nothing is changed)

==> raum.yaml: profile
  + raum.yaml: profile: mock -> spark

==> Linux: system packages
  no apt-get: install curl git rsync jq ffmpeg cmake nftables libportaudio2 and docker by hand

==> uv (system-wide, /usr/local/bin)
  + curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sudo env UV_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local/bin UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh

==> Node.js >= 20.19 (Vite 8)
  node v24.22.1 present

==> Ollama
  + curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
  + sudo mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service.d
  + sudo install -m 0644 <repo>/deploy/systemd/ollama-raum.conf /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service.d/raum.conf
  + sudo systemctl daemon-reload
  + sudo systemctl restart ollama

==> user raum and directories
  + sudo useradd --system --create-home --home-dir /opt/raum --shell /usr/sbin/nologin raum
  + sudo chmod 0755 /opt/raum
  + sudo install -d -o <user> -m 0755 /opt/raum/python
  + sudo install -d -o raum -g raum -m 0700 /var/lib/raum
  + sudo install -d -o root -g raum -m 0750 /etc/raum
  note: the services expect the repo at /opt/raum/app (this one is <repo>).
        Push it there from the laptop with deploy/push.sh, or clone it there and rerun.
  + sudo install -d -o <user> -m 0755 /opt/raum/app
  + write /etc/raum/raum.env (0640 root:raum):
      # RAUM service environment (see deploy/raum.env.example). Written by install.sh.
      RAUM_PROFILE=spark
      RAUM_HOME=/opt/raum/app
      RAUM_DATA_DIR=/var/lib/raum

==> Python environment and app build
  + env UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/raum/python bash -c cd '<repo>/core' && /usr/local/bin/uv sync --frozen
  + env UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/raum/python bash -c cd '<repo>/app' && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build

==> whisper.cpp (large-v3-turbo) in /opt/raum/whisper.cpp
  + sudo install -d -o <user> -m 0755 /opt/raum/whisper.cpp
  + env UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/raum/python bash -c git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp '/opt/raum/whisper.cpp'
  + env UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/raum/python bash -c cmake -S '/opt/raum/whisper.cpp' -B '/opt/raum/whisper.cpp/build' -DGGML_CUDA=1 -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=native -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build '/opt/raum/whisper.cpp/build' -j --config Release --target whisper-server
  model ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin: download with --pull-models (or /opt/raum/whisper.cpp/models/download-ggml-model.sh large-v3-turbo)

==> Ollama models for spark
  skipped (add --pull-models): bge-m3 gemma4:26b gpt-oss:120b

==> systemd units
  + sudo install -m 0644 <repo>/deploy/systemd/raum-nft.service /etc/systemd/system/raum-nft.service
  + sudo install -m 0644 <repo>/deploy/systemd/whisper.service /etc/systemd/system/whisper.service
  + sudo install -m 0644 <repo>/deploy/systemd/raum-core.service /etc/systemd/system/raum-core.service
  + sudo install -m 0644 <repo>/deploy/systemd/raum-agent.service /etc/systemd/system/raum-agent.service
  + sudo systemctl daemon-reload
  user ollama missing: creating it so deploy/raum.nft can load
  + sudo useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin ollama
  + sudo systemctl enable --now raum-nft whisper raum-core raum-agent

==> LiveKit + Caddy (docker compose)
  + write <repo>/deploy/.env (0644 <user>:<group>):
      # docker compose settings (see deploy/env.example). Written by install.sh.

      RAUM_NODE_IP=127.0.0.1
